BiblicalUsage: gᵉdîy — kid, young male goat. That is the whole of it, and it is enough: 16 occurrences, and in Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, and Judges the meaning never wavers. I keep coming back to the simple reading because the simple reading is the true one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gᵉdîy matters because even a small offering, given as God commanded, mattered to Him. I hold that the simple reading is the true one, and I will not trade it for a clever one.
RelatedEvents: Jacob Receives Isaac's Blessing; Gideon's Victory over Midian
